brief: Two-day workshop in Leipzig for 30 people, 1 night, arriving 2027-02-16. Keep it as cheap as possible, budget EUR 10,000.

input.summary: Two Leipzig seminar hotels are open on 2027-02-16 and comply with policy, and both are under the EUR 10,000 budget. The cheapest Leipzig option, Kesselhalle Plagwitz (EUR 7,770), is on the blocked vendor list, so I left it out. Only three Leipzig venues matched, so the shortlist has two offers.

offers.tradeOff: Cheapest compliant option, with 4 workshop rooms and a maker space; it costs EUR 420 less than Auwald but is not a preferred vendor.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Preferred vendor in a calm floodplain setting; it costs EUR 420 more than Druckerei Forum and has 3 breakout rooms instead of 4.

rfp.subject: Request for proposal: 2-day workshop, Leipzig, arriving 2027-02-16
rfp.body:
Hello,

We are planning a two-day workshop and would like a proposal.

Dates: arrival 2027-02-16, 1 night (departure 2027-02-17)
Guests: 30
Room nights: 30 single rooms, 1 night
Meeting space: one main meeting room for 30 people on both days. No separate breakout rooms are needed.
Catering: lunch and coffee for 30 on both days (60 day delegate packages)
Dietary needs: none reported
Accessibility: no wheelchair users; please confirm step-free access anyway.
Budget: our total budget is EUR 10,000, so please quote your best all-in price.

Please reply by 2026-11-15 with availability, a price breakdown and your terms.

Thank you,
Demo Co. Events
